title: Aerial Orthoimagery Phase 2 Leaf-off (3" & 6")
description:
This collection contains Phase 2 Kentucky From Above 4-band 3" and 6" orthoimagery collected from 2019 - 2023.

Aerial imagery was acquired using a UltraCam Eagle camera and was supplemented with the simultaneous acquisition of airborne GPS/IMU data, which captured the ground coordinate for the nadir point of each photograph.

All acquisitions occurred during the Spring, leaf-off season during minimal shadow conditions and when the sun angle was greater than 30° above the horizon.  Other requirements included conditions free from clouds and shadows, smoke, haze, light streaks, snow, ice on water bodies, foliage, flooding, and excessive soil moisture.

For further information on technical specifications, refer to the KyFromAbove [Technical Specifications Documentation](https://kygeonet.ky.gov/kyfromabove/pdfs/Specs_OrthoPhoto_Production.pdf)
